_metadata.description: Switch the preview iframe's theme between built-in themes and themes derived from a target scenario's DESIGN.md.

requirements.title: Built-in themes are seeded into the registry and selectable from the UI
requirements.description: `builtin_themes` (id, name, tokens_json) is seeded and migrated in place at boot with light, dark, and high-contrast token-contract themes. `ThemesService.ListBuiltinThemes` lists them; `GetBuiltinTheme` returns tokens. Seeding/migration is idempotent.

validation.notes: Themes service migration/seed tests cover light, dark, and high-contrast contract tokens; UI ThemeSwitcher and preview bridge tests cover selection and follow-app behavior.

requirements.title: Target scenario's DESIGN.md is resolved server-side to normalized JSON
requirements.description: `ThemesService.GetThemeFromScenario` (Connect-RPC) reads the named scenario's `DESIGN.md` via the storage resolver (path-traversal-guarded under the adoptions scenarios root), parses the YAML front-matter using the canonical `vrooli-default` schema (colors, typography, rounded, spacing), and returns a flat CSS-custom-property token map (e.g. `--color-primary`, `--rounded-sm`, `--typography-body-md-fontfamily`). Malformed front-matter → ErrInvalidDesignMD (Connect InvalidArgument). The client never builds the URL or parses DESIGN.md directly.

validation.notes: internal/themes/design_md_test.go covers ExtractFrontMatter (happy + missing + unclosed) and ParseDesignMDToTheme (flow-verifier fixture, empty-shape rejection, bad-YAML rejection). service_test.go::TestResolveFromScenario_OK + Missing pin the wiring.

requirements.title: Preview harness mounts the selected theme as CSS custom properties before render
requirements.description: The Appearance & visual checks menu explains and selects token sources. When a built-in pack or a scenario's server-resolved DESIGN.md theme is selected, the host posts normalized tokens via the bridge. The harness child applies them as CSS custom properties on `:root` before mounting the component, then triggers a re-render; this token axis never changes the color-scheme mode.

validation.notes: handlers/preview/module_test.go::TestModule_HarnessHTML asserts the harness installs the rcl-theme-apply listener and uses documentElement.style.setProperty to apply each token. UI: features/components/ThemeSwitcher.test.tsx covers built-in selection + scenario-resolved Apply, verifying the host posts {type:rcl-theme-apply, themeId, tokens} with the expected token map.
